units.source_text: 但愿人们能洞察我所想说的事。

en.t: I only hope that people can perceive what I am trying to say.

units.source_text: 再说，这时金阁又出现了。

en.t: Besides, at that moment the Golden Pavilion appeared again.

units.source_text: 应该说，乳房变形成为金阁了。

en.t: More precisely, the breasts had transformed into the Golden Pavilion.
